elements.requirement: An adjoining owner must pay all expenses that are to be defrayed by that adjoining owner in accordance with an account served under section 13.
elements.quote: All expenses to be defrayed by an adjoining owner in accordance with an account served under section 13 shall be paid by the adjoining owner

elements.requirement: The property in any works executed under the Act to which the expenses relate is vested solely in the building owner until the adjoining owner pays those expenses to the building owner.
elements.quote: Until an adjoining owner pays to the building owner such expenses as aforesaid the property in any works executed under this Act to which the expenses relate shall be vested solely in the building owner
